name: Spice
notes: SoA_Plant_SpiceBloom is leftover plant art/data; live melange comes from spice blows.

sections.body: Incident SoA_SpiceBlow places a cluster of SoA_SpiceField beds. Each field yields 25–80 raw spice and lasts 180000–480000 ticks. After the map is empty of fields, SoASpiceCadenceTuning guarantees another blow in 4–10 days (expected ~7).
sections.title: Spice blows

sections.body: Hand harvest and the portable spice extractor both scrape SoA_RawSpice. The extractor on a deposit uses 90 mining work per 2 spice and strong machine vibration; open-sand sifting is 2400 work per 1 spice and half that vibration. Spice prospecting research is required to build the extractor.
sections.title: Harvesting

sections.body: Recipe SoA_ProcessSpice turns 10 raw spice into 4 melange doses at a drug lab after Arrakis survival. A dose inflicts SoA_SpiceAwareness. Smuggler traders stock spice tags.
sections.title: Refining and use

code.purpose: Spice extractor deposit scrape and open-sand sift

summary: Melange appears as finite open-sand blows, not as a farmable crop. Harvesting it is loud.
